Many stories include "page", "view", "link", "menu", "WYSIWYG editor", "checkbox", "stripe", "SEO friendly URL path", "third step process", "second page registration" etc. Need identify if solution prescribed unnecessarily.

However, some UI "view/list" may be interface need? User story format often includes "want to view X" as need, not necessarily implementation. Need distinguish: "want to view a list of sponsors" not concrete widget? It is a functional need. The criterion penalizes concrete UI widgets or mechanisms. Examples: "green Save button in upper-right corner" violation. "stored in Redis queue and delivered by cron job" violation. "submit expense claim" no violation. "be notified" no violation.
